chunks: And from his instruction to him (peace be upon him) for Ma'qil ibn Qays al-Riyahi when he dispatched him to Syria at the head of a vanguard of three thousand.

key_terms.الرِّيَاحِيُّ: Al-Riyahi, the nisba indicating lineage or origin from al-Riha
key_terms.الشَّام: Syria, the region targeted for military engagement
key_terms.مَعْقِلُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ: Ma'qil ibn Qays, a companion of the Prophet and early Islamic figure
key_terms.مُقَدِّمَةً: A vanguard or leading contingent of troops

ai.seo_question: Who was dispatched to Syria with a vanguard of three thousand soldiers by the Imam?
ai.summary: This narration from Nahj al-Balagha records Imam Ali's dispatch of Ma'qil ibn Qays al-Riyahi to Syria with a vanguard of three thousand, illustrating the practical application of his military strategy during the Battle of Siffin. It underscores the Imam's dual role as both a spiritual leader and a decisive commander, emphasizing the importance of organized, disciplined forces in early Islamic governance.
